title: 5 Heist Shows : You'll ROOT for the ROBBERS
description: A fast-paced countdown of five heist and robbery series from 2022 onwards, from #5 up to #1. Open with a punchy 2-sentence hook: master thieves, impossible vaults and plans with ten moving parts, these five shows are built to be binged in one weekend. Then go straight in. About 40 seconds per show: (1) the lead actor and their character, and the streamer; (2) the setup in two or three concrete sentences: the crew, the target and who is hunting them; (3) the hook that makes it bingeable, without spoilers. For Lupin, focus on Part 3 (2023) and Season 4 (2026): Assane in prison, framed by a copycat, forced to break out. Mention that Kaleidoscope can be watched in any order, that Berlin is the prequel spin-off of Money Heist, that Bandidos is Mexican (Spanish with subtitles), and that 12 12 12 is brand new on Apple TV.
